lines.text: God tells Israel to divide the land equally among the twelve tribes, with Reuben receiving two portions.
Foreigners who live among them and have children are to be treated as native-born Israelites and receive an inheritance.
The holy portion for the priests goes to the descendants of Zadok, with the sanctuary at its center.
The land on both sides of the holy portion and the city property will belong to the prince.
The city gates are named after the tribes of Israel, and from that day the city will be named THE LORD IS PEACE.
